experiments.title: Verify fingerprint
experiments.instructions: Automatic verification against all enrolled fingerprints. Keep the sensor clear while opening, then touch when prompted.
experiments.next_steps: Verification finished. The agent will inspect the outcome and metrics from the private logs.

experiments.title: Enroll fingerprint
experiments.instructions: Enroll the selected finger with consecutive touches on the reader.
experiments.next_steps: New fingerprint enrolled and saved in system fprintd.

experiments.title: Delete fingerprint
experiments.instructions: Removes the selected fingerprint from the system fprintd database.
experiments.next_steps: Fingerprint removed from the system database.

experiments.title: List enrolled fingerprints
experiments.instructions: Queries fprintd and shows which fingers are enrolled on the system.
